Rage: A barbarian can call upon inner reserves of strength and ferocity. She gains a +4 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution, a +2 morale bonus on Will saves, and takes a -2 penalty to AC for 4 + Con modifier rounds per day (+2 rounds/level).
Greater Rage: At 11th level, when a barbarian enters rage, the morale bonus to Strength and Constitution increases to +6 and the morale bonus on Will saves increases to +3.
Mighty Rage: At 20th level, when a barbarian enters rage, the morale bonus to Strength and Constitution increases to +8 and the morale bonus on Will saves increases to +4.
Fast Movement: A barbarian's land speed is faster than the norm for her race by +10 feet. This benefit applies only when she is wearing no armor, light armor, or medium armor, and not carrying a heavy load.
Trap Sense: At 3rd level, a barbarian or rogue gains a +1 bonus on Reflex saves made to avoid traps and a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks made by traps (+1 every 3 levels thereafter).
Damage Reduction (Barbarian): At 7th level, a barbarian gains Damage Reduction 1/-. This DR increases by 1/- every three barbarian levels thereafter (up to DR 5/- at 19th level).
Indomitable Will: At 14th level, a barbarian gains a +4 bonus on Will saves to resist enchantment spells while raging.
Tireless Rage: Starting at 17th level, a barbarian is no longer fatigued at the end of her rage.
Bardic Performance: A bard uses the Perform skill to create magical effects on allies and foes. Starting at 1st level, can perform 4 + Cha mod rounds/day (+2 rounds/level). Includes Inspire Courage, Countersong, Distraction, Fascinate, Inspire Competence, Suggestion, Dirge of Doom, Inspire Greatness, Soothing Performance, Frightening Tune, and Inspire Heroics.
Inspire Courage: Allies receive a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against charm and fear effects and a +1 competence bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls (+1 at 5th, 11th, and 17th level).
Countersong: A bard can counter magical effects that depend on sound by using Perform (keyboard, percussion, wind, string, or sing). Any creature within 30 ft. may use the bard's Perform check in place of its saving throw.
Distraction: A bard can counter visual magical effects (illusions, patterns) using Perform (act, comedy, dance, or pantomime). Allies within 30 ft. can use the bard's Perform check in place of their saving throws.
Fascinate: Causes up to one creature per 3 bard levels within 90 feet to become fascinated with the bard (taking -4 on reaction skill checks such as Perception).
Inspire Competence: Grants an ally within 30 feet a +2 competence bonus on skill checks with a particular skill (+1 every 4 levels beyond 3rd).
Suggestion (Bard): At 6th level, a bard can make a suggestion (as the spell) to a fascinated creature on a failed Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 bard level + Cha mod).
Dirge of Doom: At 8th level, a bard causes all enemies within 30 feet who can see and hear him to become shaken automatically with no saving throw.
Inspire Greatness: At 9th level, grants an ally +2 bonus Hit Dice (d10s with Con bonus, BAB, and Fort save bonuses), a +2 competence bonus on attacks, and a +1 competence bonus on Fort saves.
Soothing Performance: At 12th level, a bard's 4-round performance cures 3d8+Cha mod damage to all allies within 30 feet and removes fatigued, sickened, and shaken conditions.
Frightening Tune: At 14th level, causes all enemies within 30 feet who fail a Will save to become panicked for 1d4 rounds.
Inspire Heroics: At 15th level, grants an ally a +4 morale bonus on saving throws and a +4 dodge bonus to AC.
Bardic Knowledge: A bard adds 1/2 his class level (minimum +1) to all Knowledge skill checks and may make all Knowledge skill checks untrained.
Versatile Performance: At 2nd level, a bard can substitute his bonus in a chosen Perform skill for the bonus in associated skills (e.g., Act for Bluff/Disguise, Oratory for Diplomacy/Sense Motive).
Lore Master: At 5th level, a bard can take 10 on any Knowledge skill check. A number of times per day, he can take 20 on a Knowledge check as a standard action.
Jack of All Trades: At 10th level, a bard can use any skill untrained. At 16th level, all skills are class skills. At 19th level, he can take 10 on any skill check.
Channel Energy (Cleric): Clerics can release a 30-foot burst of positive or negative energy 3 + Cha mod times/day, healing living/damaging undead or damaging living/healing undead for 1d6 (+1d6 every 2 levels). Will DC 10 + 1/2 cleric level + Cha mod for half.
Domains: A cleric chooses two domains from her deity's portfolio, granting domain powers, bonus domain spells, and granted domain abilities.
Spontaneous Casting: A good cleric (or neutral cleric of a good deity) can channel stored spell energy to spontaneously cast cure spells in place of prepared spells; evil clerics spontaneously cast inflict spells.
Nature Bond: At 1st level, a druid forms a bond with nature in the form of either a cleric domain (Air, Animal, Earth, Fire, Plant, Water, Weather) or an animal companion.
Nature Sense: A druid gains a +2 bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks.
Wild Empathy: Improves the initial attitude of animals as a Diplomacy check, adding druid level + Cha mod.
Woodland Stride: Allows movement through non-magical undergrowth (briars, bushes, overgrown areas) at normal speed without taking damage or impairment.
Trackless Step: Starting at 3rd level, a druid leaves no trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked.
Resist Nature's Lure: At 4th level, a druid gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against the spell-like and supernatural abilities of fey.
Wild Shape: At 4th level, a druid can turn into Small or Medium animals 1/day (as beast shape I). Scales to Diminutive, Huge, elemental, and plant forms for 1 hour/level.
Venom Immunity: At 9th level, a druid gains immunity to all poisons.
A Thousand Faces: At 13th level, a druid gains the ability to change her appearance at will, as if using the alter self spell.
Timeless Body: At 15th level, a druid no longer takes ability score penalties for aging and cannot be magically aged.
Bonus Feats (Fighter): A fighter gains a bonus combat feat at 1st level and every even-numbered level thereafter (2nd, 4th, 6th, etc.), selecting from any combat feats whose prerequisites he meets.
Bravery: At 2nd level, a fighter gains a +1 bonus on Will saves against fear (+1 every 4 levels up to +5 at 18th level).
Armor Training: At 3rd level, reduces armor check penalty by 1 and increases max Dex bonus by +1 (+1 every 4 levels up to -4 ACP / +4 Max Dex). Allows full speed in medium armor (3rd) and heavy armor (7th).
Weapon Training: Starting at 5th level, grants +1 on attack and damage rolls with a chosen weapon group (+1 every 4 levels, up to +4 at 17th level).
Armor Mastery: At 20th level, a fighter gains DR 5/- whenever he is wearing armor or using a shield.
Weapon Mastery: At 20th level, chosen weapon automatically confirms critical threats, critical multiplier increases by +1, and the fighter cannot be disarmed of it.
Flurry of Blows: As a full-attack action, a monk can make one additional unarmed strike or monk weapon attack using his full monk level as base attack bonus.
Unarmed Strike (Monk): Monks deal lethal or nonlethal unarmed damage starting at 1d6 (Medium) and scaling up to 2d10 at 20th level, retaining their full Strength bonus on all attacks.
Evasion: If a monk makes a successful Reflex save against an effect that allows a save for half damage, he takes no damage instead.
Still Mind: At 3rd level, a monk gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.
Ki Pool: At 4th level, a monk has 1/2 monk level + Wis mod ki points. Can spend 1 ki to make an extra flurry attack, increase speed by +20 ft., or gain +4 dodge AC for 1 round.
Slow Fall: Allows a monk within reach of a wall to reduce falling distance when calculating damage (up to any distance at 20th level).
Purity of Body: At 5th level, a monk gains immunity to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases.
Wholeness of Body: At 7th level, a monk can heal his own wounds by spending 2 ki points, healing HP equal to his monk level.
Diamond Body: At 11th level, a monk gains immunity to poisons of all kinds.
Abundant Step: At 12th level, a monk can slip magically between spaces, as if using the dimension door spell, by spending 2 ki points.
Diamond Soul: At 13th level, a monk gains Spell Resistance equal to his current monk level + 10.
Quivering Palm: At 15th level, a monk can set up lethal vibrations in an opponent's body once per day (Fortitude save DC 10 + 1/2 monk level + Wis mod or die).
Empty Body: At 19th level, a monk can become ethereal for 1 minute by spending 3 ki points (as ethereal jaunt).
Perfect Self: At 20th level, the monk becomes an outsider (native) and gains DR 10/chaotic.
Aura of Good: A paladin radiates a powerful aura of good equal to her paladin level.
Detect Evil: At will, a paladin can focus on a creature or object to detect evil, as the detect evil spell.
Smite Evil: As a swift action, adds Charisma bonus to attack rolls and paladin level to damage rolls (+2 dmg/lvl vs evil dragons/undead/outsiders on 1st hit), and gains deflection AC equal to Cha mod against the target.
Divine Grace: At 2nd level, a paladin adds her Charisma bonus (if any) as a bonus on all saving throws.
Lay on Hands: Heals 1d6 HP per two paladin levels 1/2 level + Cha mod times per day, or deals equal damage to undead with a melee touch attack.
Divine Health: At 3rd level, a paladin gains immunity to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases.
Mercy: At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, the paladin's lay on hands cures specific conditions (Fatigued, Shaken, Sickened, Dazed, Diseased, Staggered, Cursed, Exhausted, Frightened, Nauseated, Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned).
Divine Bond: At 5th level, forms a bond with a celestial weapon spirit (granting enhancement bonuses/special qualities) or a celestial warhorse mount.
Holy Champion: At 20th level, paladin gains DR 10/evil, and smite evil automatically banishes evil outsiders on a failed Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 level + Cha mod).
Favored Enemy: Grants +2 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, Survival, and weapon attack/damage rolls against chosen creature type (+2 every 5 levels).
Track: A ranger adds 1/2 his class level (minimum +1) to Survival checks made to follow tracks.
Combat Style Feat: At 2nd level and every 4 levels thereafter, selects a combat style (Archery, Two-Weapon, Crossbow, Great Weapon, Mounted, Natural Weapon, Sword and Shield) and gains bonus feats ignoring prerequisites.
Favored Terrain: Grants +2 on initiative, Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks in selected terrain (+2 every 5 levels).
Hunter's Bond: At 4th level, bonds with companions (sharing 1/2 favored enemy bonus) or gains an animal companion.
Quarry: At 11th level, designates a target as a standard action, gaining +2 insight bonus on attacks and auto-confirming critical hits.
Camouflage: At 12th level, uses Stealth in favored terrain even without cover or concealment.
Hide in Plain Sight (Ranger): At 17th level, uses Stealth in favored terrain even while being observed.
Master Hunter: At 20th level, can make an attack against a favored enemy that forces a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 level + Wis mod) or die.
Sneak Attack: Deals +1d6 precision damage (+1d6 every 2 levels) against flanked or flat-footed targets.
Trapfinding: Adds 1/2 rogue level to Perception checks to locate traps and Disable Device checks, and can disarm magical traps.
Rogue Talents: Gains special rogue talents every 2 levels (Bleeding Attack, Combat Trick, Fast Stealth, Minor Magic, Major Magic, Trap Spotter, Resiliency).
Uncanny Dodge: Retains Dex bonus to AC even when flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker.
Improved Uncanny Dodge: Cannot be flanked except by a rogue with at least 4 more rogue levels.
Advanced Talents: At 10th level, selects advanced talents (Crippling Strike, Defensive Roll, Opportunist, Slippery Mind, Skill Mastery, Feat).
Master Strike: At 20th level, a sneak attack can put a foe into a coma for 1d4 hours, paralyze it for 2d6 rounds, or slay it instantly (Fort DC 10 + 1/2 level + Int mod).
Bloodline Arcana: Sorcerers gain a unique passive magical enhancement from their bloodline affecting specific spell categories or elements.
Bloodline Powers: Supernatural and spell-like abilities granted by a sorcerer's bloodline at 1st, 3rd, 9th, 15th, and 20th level.
Eschew Materials: Sorcerers gain Eschew Materials as a bonus feat at 1st level, casting spells without non-costly material components.
Arcane Bond: Wizards bond with an object (recasting 1 prepared spell/day) or a familiar (granting senses and touch delivery).
Arcane School: Wizards gain bonus spell slots, unique school abilities, and declare two opposition schools.
Scribe Scroll: Wizards gain Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat at 1st level.
Alchemy (Alchemist): Alchemists prepare magical extracts like potions and create potent alchemical substances with swift efficiency.
Bomb: Throws volatile bombs dealing 1d6 + Int fire damage (+1d6 every 2 levels) for level + Int times/day.
Mutagen: Brews a physical mutagen granting +4 alchemical bonus to Str, Dex, or Con, +2 natural armor, and -2 to mental stat for 10 min/level.
Discoveries: Alchemists learn discoveries modifying bombs, body modifications, and alchemical extracts every 2 levels.
Swift Alchemy: At 3rd level, crafts alchemical items in half the normal time.
Poison Use: Alchemists are trained in the use of poison and never risk accidentally poisoning themselves when applying poison to a weapon.
Challenge: Designates an opponent as a swift action, dealing +cavalier level damage with melee attacks (-2 AC against other attackers).
Tactician: Grants a teamwork feat to all allies within 30 feet for 3 rounds + 1/2 level.
Cavalier's Charge: At 3rd level, gains +4 bonus on attack rolls on a mounted charge and takes no AC penalty.
Mighty Charge: At 11th level, gains a free combat maneuver (bull rush, disarm, sunder, or trip) on a charge and doubles weapon threat range.
Supreme Charge: At 20th level, mounted charge deals double damage (triple with a lance) and can stun on a critical hit.
Grit: Has grit points equal to Wis mod (min 1). Regains grit on confirming a firearm critical hit or reducing an enemy to 0 HP.
Deeds: Spends grit to perform firearm deeds (Deadeye, Gunslinger's Dodge, Quick Clear, Utility Shot, Dead Shot, Targeting, Bleeding Wound).
Gunsmith: Gains a battered starting firearm and the Gunsmithing feat, crafting and repairing firearms at reduced cost.
Nimble: Gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC while wearing light or no armor (+1 every 4 levels up to +5 at 20th level).
Gun Training: At 5th level, adds Dex modifier to firearm damage with chosen firearm type and reduces misfire value by 1.
Judgment: Pronounces judgment as a swift action, choosing bonuses to destruction, healing, justice, piercing, protection, purity, resiliency, resistance, or smiting.
Monster Lore: Adds Wisdom modifier in addition to Intelligence modifier on Knowledge skill checks to identify monster abilities and weaknesses.
Stern Gaze: Adds 1/2 inquisitor level (minimum +1) on Intimidate and Sense Motive checks.
Cunning Initiative: Adds Wisdom modifier in addition to Dexterity modifier on initiative checks.
Solo Tactics: All of the inquisitor's allies are treated as if they had the same teamwork feats as the inquisitor for determining teamwork bonuses.
Bane (Inquisitor): Imbues weapon with bane special quality as a swift action (+2 attack, +2d6 damage vs selected creature type) for level rounds/day.
Arcane Pool: Has an arcane pool equal to 1/2 magus level + Int mod. Can spend 1 point as a swift action to grant weapon +1 enhancement bonus (+1 per 4 levels) or special weapon qualities.
Spell Combat: As a full-round action, casts a spell with standard casting time and makes all melee weapon attacks at a -2 penalty.
Spellstrike: Delivers touch spells through a melee weapon attack at full BAB instead of a melee touch attack.
Magus Arcana: Learns unique magus arcana (Concentration, Arcane Accuracy, Familiar, Flamboyant Arcana, Hasted Assault, Spell Blending) every 3 levels.
Spell Recall: At 4th level, spends arcane pool points equal to spell level to spontaneously recall and recast a prepared spell.
Mystery: An oracle's divine mystery grants class skills, bonus spells, and revelations.
Oracle's Curse: An irrevocable supernatural affliction (Clouded Vision, Deaf, Haunted, Lame, Tongues, Wasting) providing distinct immunity boons.
Revelations: Supernatural divine abilities chosen from the oracle's mystery every 4 levels.
Hexes: Witches cast supernatural hexes (Evil Eye, Misfortune, Slumber, Cackle, Healing, Fortune, Flight) with DC 10 + 1/2 level + Int mod.
Eidolon: Summoners summon a powerful customizable outsider companion shaped with evolution points (natural attacks, limbs, flight, reach, magic).
Arcane Reservoir: An arcanist's pool of magical energy (3 + level) fueling exploits and boosting spell DC or caster level by +1.
Bloodrage: Bloodragers enter a violent rage gaining +4 Str/Con, +2 Will saves, -2 AC, bloodline powers, and casting bloodrager spells during rage.
Martial Flexibility: Brawlers gain the benefit of any combat feat for 1 minute as a move action, adapting to any combat scenario.
Animal Focus: Hunters take on the aspects of animals (Bull, Bear, Falcon, Tiger, Snake, Wolf, Owl) granting stat bonuses and senses.
Inspiration: Investigators spend inspiration from a pool (1/2 level + Int mod) to add 1d6 to skill checks, attacks, or saves.
Studied Combat: Investigators study a foe as a move action, gaining +1/2 level insight bonus to melee attacks and damage.
Studied Strike: Investigators expend studied combat to deal +1d6 precision damage (+1d6 every 2 levels beyond 4th).
Raging Song: Skalds inspire allies with Inspired Rage (+2 Str/Con, +1 Will, -1 AC, rage powers) for 4 + Cha mod rounds/day.
Studied Target: Slayers study a target as a move action, gaining +1 on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, Survival, and attack/damage (+1 every 5 levels).
Panache: Swashbucklers use panache points (equal to Cha mod) to execute deeds like Opportune Parry and Riposte and Dodging Panache.
Opportune Parry and Riposte: When an opponent makes a melee attack against the swashbuckler, she can spend 1 panache point and expend an attack of opportunity to attempt to parry that attack with an attack roll. If successful, the attack misses, and she can make an immediate riposte attack if within reach.
Sacred Weapon: Warpriests enhance weapons to deal base damage based on warpriest level and apply magical weapon properties as a swift action.
Fervor: Warpriests channel divine power 1/2 level + Wis mod times/day to heal/damage or cast self-buff spells as a swift action.
Burn: Kineticists accept nonlethal damage (1 point of burn = 1 point nonlethal per HD) to empower kinetic blasts, infusions, and wild talents.
Kinetic Blast: Unleashes elemental physical or energy blasts as a standard action, scaling by 1d6 (energy) or 1d6+1 (physical) per 2 levels.
Gather Power: A kineticist channels elemental energy as a move or full-round action to reduce the burn cost of a kinetic blast by 1 or 2 points.
Hypnotic Stare: Mesmerists focus their stare on a target within 30 feet as a swift action, imposing a -2 penalty on Will saves.
Painful Stare: Deals extra damage (1 + 1/2 level) to a target affected by hypnotic stare when struck in combat.
Mental Focus: Occultists invest mental focus points into implement schools to unlock resonant powers and focus powers.
Phrenic Amplifications: Psychics spend phrenic pool points to modify psychic spells (increasing DC, bypassing SR, adding debuffs).
Phantom: Spiritualists manifest a spiritual phantom companion tied to an emotional focus (Anger, Dedication, Despair, Fear, Hatred, Jealousy, Zeal).
